arxiv-1704-04380.title: Precise simulation of single-hole spin control in quantum dots
arxiv-1704-04380.creator: YuanDong Wang, JingHan Ni, JianHua Wei
arxiv-1704-04380.description: Abstract The precise simulation of the initialization, control, and read-out of a single-hole spin qubit is investigated by accurately solving the extended Anderson impurity model in the real time domain with the hierarchical equations of motion approach. The initialization is realized by the ionization of an exciton with high fidelity.

arxiv-2112-07390.title: Comment on “A Candidate for a Supergravity Anomaly”
arxiv-2112-07390.description: Abstract In a recent paper (arXiv:2110.06213v1) it was argued that in 4D supergravity a previously unknown candidate anomaly exists. In the present paper it is pointed out that the existence of such a candidate would contradict results available in the literature, and it is substantiated that there is no candidate anomaly of the asserted form.

arxiv-2205-09078.title: Dynamic Resource Allocation: Algorithmic Design Principles and Spectrum of Achievable Performances
arxiv-2205-09078.creator: Omar Besbes, Yash Kanoria, Akshit Kumar
arxiv-2205-09078.description: Abstract Dynamic resource allocation problems are ubiquitous, arising in inventory management, order fulfillment, online advertising, and other applications. We initially focus on one of the simplest models of online resource allocation: the multisecretary problem. In the multisecretary problem, a decision maker sequentially hires up to B B out of T T candidates, and candidate ability values are drawn i.i.d.

arxiv-2208-06654.title: Global stability of the compressible viscous surface waves in an infinite layer
arxiv-2208-06654.creator: Guilong Gui, Zhifei Zhang
arxiv-2208-06654.description: Abstract . We investigate in this paper the global stability of the compressible viscous surface waves in the absence of surface tension effect with a steady-state violating Rayleigh-Taylor instability and the reference domain being the horizontal infinite layer. The fluid dynamics are governed by the 3-D gravity-driven isentropic compressible Navier-Stokes equations.

arxiv-2311-15107.title: Rheology of suspensions of non-Brownian soft spheres across the jamming and viscous-to-inertial transitions
arxiv-2311-15107.creator: Franco Tapia, Chong-Wei Hong, Pascale Aussillous, Élisabeth Guazzelli
arxiv-2311-15107.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Franco Tapia, Chong-Wei Hong, Pascale Aussillous, Élisabeth Guazzelli. The rheology of suspensions of non-Brownian soft spheres is studied across jamming but also across the viscous and inertial regimes using a custom pressure- and volume-imposed rheometer. The study shows that the granular rheology found for suspensions of hard spheres can be extended to a soft granular rheology (SGranR) by renormalizing the critical volume fraction and friction coefficient to pressure-dependent values and using the addition of the viscous and inertial stress scales.

arxiv-2404-01998.title: Specularity Factorization for Low-Light Enhancement
arxiv-2404-01998.creator: Saurabh Saini, P J Narayanan
arxiv-2404-01998.description: Abstract We present a new additive image factorization technique that treats images to be composed of multiple latent specular components which can be simply estimated recursively by modulating the sparsity during decomposition. Our model-driven RSFNet estimates these factors by unrolling the optimization into network layers requiring only a few scalars to be learned.

arxiv-2405-17112.title: Using continuation methods to analyse the difficulty of problems solved by Ising machines
arxiv-2405-17112.creator: Jacob Lamers, Guy Verschaffelt, Guy Van der Sande
arxiv-2405-17112.description: Abstract Ising machines are dedicated hardware solvers of NP-hard optimization problems. However, they do not always find the most optimal solution. The probability of finding this optimal solution depends on the problem at hand. Using continuation methods, we show that this is closely linked to the bifurcation sequence of the optimal solution.

arxiv-2406-18433.title: A Nesterov-style Accelerated Gradient Descent Algorithm for the Symmetric Eigenvalue Problem
arxiv-2406-18433.creator: Foivos Alimisis, Simon Vary, Bart Vandereycken
arxiv-2406-18433.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Foivos Alimisis, Simon Vary, Bart Vandereycken. We develop an accelerated gradient descent algorithm on the Grassmann manifold to compute the subspace spanned by a number of leading eigenvectors of a symmetric positive semi-definite matrix. This has a constant cost per iteration and a provable iteration complexity of 𝒪 ~ ​ ( 1 / δ ) \tilde{\mathcal{O}}(1/\sqrt{\delta}) , where δ \delta is the spectral gap and 𝒪 ~ \tilde{\mathcal{O}} hides logarithmic factors.

arxiv-2502-10151.title: Semantica: Decentralized Search using a LLM-Guided Semantic Tree Overlay
arxiv-2502-10151.creator: Petru Neague 1 , Quinten Stokkink 1 , Naman Goel 2 , Johan Pouwelse 1
arxiv-2502-10151.description: Abstract Centralized search engines are key for the Internet, but lead to undesirable concentration of power. Decentralized alternatives fail to offer equal document retrieval accuracy and speed. Nevertheless, Semantic Overlay Networks can come close to the performance of centralized solutions when the semantics of documents are properly captured.

arxiv-2508-13291.title: Development of Turbulence in Post-shock Regions
arxiv-2508-13291.creator: Michael M. Foley, Philip Mocz, Blakesley Burkhart, Lars Hernquist, Alyssa Goodman
arxiv-2508-13291.description: Abstract Supersonic isothermal turbulence is ubiquitous in the interstellar medium. This work presents high-resolution AREPO hydrodynamical simulations of isolated shocks moving through supersonic turbulence to study the development and evolution of turbulence in the pre- and post-shock regions. We find that shocks can amplify turbulent energy in the post-shock region while inducing a preferential orientation for the vorticity.

arxiv-2509-08052.title: Taking the Weight Off: Mitigating Parameter Bias from Catastrophic Outliers in 3 × \times 2pt Analysis
arxiv-2509-08052.creator: Shahab Joudaki
arxiv-2509-08052.description: Abstract Stage IV cosmological surveys will map the universe with unprecedented precision, reducing statistical uncertainties to levels where unmodelled systematics can significantly bias inference. In particular, photometric redshift (photo- z z ) errors and intrinsic alignments (IA) must be robustly accounted for to ensure accurate inference of cosmological parameters.

europmc-pmc2836990.title: Dynamics of muscle fibre growth during postnatal mouse development.
europmc-pmc2836990.creator: White RB, Biérinx AS, Gnocchi VF, Zammit PS.
europmc-pmc2836990.description: Background Postnatal growth in mouse is rapid, with total skeletal muscle mass increasing several-fold in the first few weeks. Muscle growth can be achieved by either an increase in muscle fibre number or an increase in the size of individual myofibres, or a combination of both.

pmc-12382916.title: Novel Insight into Dugong Mortality: First Report of Systemic Achromobacter xylosoxidans Infection, Disseminated Intravascular Coagulation, and Associated Pathogenesis
pmc-12382916.creator: Piyaporn Eiamcharoen, Piyarat Khumraksa, Santi Ninwat, Tatsawan Suttiboon, Narissara Keawchana, Peerapon Sornying, Watcharapol Suyapoh
pmc-12382916.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Simple SummaryDugongs are endangered marine mammals found in coastal areas of South-east Asia and Australia. In this study, we report the sudden death of a dugong calf that was rescued and cared for at a rehabilitation center in Thailand. Despite receiving treatment for dehydration and an eye condition, the calf died after developing signs of a severe and rapidly progressing illness. A detailed examination revealed a serious infection caused by Achromobacter xylosoxidans, a bacterium commonly found in water.

pmc-13155317.title: Two‐Dimensional Reconfigurable Photodiode for In‐Sensor Color Filtering and Spectral Logic
pmc-13155317.creator: Xiaokun Guo, Yaoqiang Zhou, Yufeng Zhang, Xinyi Zhao, Yue Pang, Lei Tong, Zhipei Sun, Jianbin Xu
pmc-13155317.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Wavelength‐selective photodetectors are essential for applications such as hyperspectral imaging, biomedical diagnostics, and secure optical communication. Conventional photodetection systems typically rely on external filters or post‐processing to resolve spectral information, leading to increased system complexity and data transfer overhead. Here, we report a reconfigurable photodiode based on spatially patterned doped tungsten diselenide (WSe2), which exhibits two runtime switchable photodetection modes and a bidirectional wavelength‐dependent conductance modulation across the visible spectrum.

pmc-13475419.title: Purely extradural meningioma presenting as an incidental sacro-iliac joint mass
pmc-13475419.creator: Aurélien Dulaurent, Alexandre Salem, Kerman Zyani, Louis-Romée Le Nail, Loïc Bouilleau
pmc-13475419.description: We report the case of an asymptomatic 32-year-old woman in whom a 38-mm right sacroiliac mass was incidentally discovered on computed tomography. Computed tomography demonstrated a well-defined enhancing lesion centered on the right sacral ala and sacroiliac joint with sclerotic margins, without cortical destruction or presacral extension.
